mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.app_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.encrypted_pwd, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.pwd_update_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark, u.yianlian_id, d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_sort, r.status as role_status from vpn_user u left join vpn_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join vpn_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join vpn_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.del_flag = '0' and (u.app_id is null or u.app_id = '' or r.app_id = u.app_id)
mapper.select: where u.user_name = #{userName} and u.app_id = #{appId} and u.del_flag = '0'
select user_id, phonenumber from vpn_user where phonenumber = #{phonenumber} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, email from vpn_user where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into vpn_user( user_id, app_id, dept_id, user_name, nick_name, email, avatar, phonenumber, sex, password, encrypted_pwd, status, create_by, remark, yianlian_id, create_time )values( #{userId}, #{appId}, #{deptId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{phonenumber}, #{sex}, #{password}, #{encryptedPwd}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{yianlianId}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update vpn_user set avatar = #{avatar} where user_name = #{userName}
update vpn_user set password = #{password}, encrypted_pwd = #{encryptedPwd}, pwd_update_date = sysdate() where user_name = #{userName}
mapper.delete: update vpn_user set del_flag = '2' where user_id = #{userId}
